title: Blood Bridge
description: BloodBridge connects voluntary donors with patients to save lives seamlessly. A life-saving web application connecting voluntary blood donors with emergency recipients via location-aware search and donor requests.
challenges: Implementing location-based geospatial querying in MongoDB for instant nearby donor matching.
Designing a strict donor eligibility algorithm based on last donation dates and medical interval rules.
Preventing spam emergency requests through phone and email verification workflows.
futurePlans: Integrating SMS and WhatsApp API gateways for instant broadcast alerts to matching nearby donors.
Adding a real-time Interactive Map route tracking between donor and hospital location.
Developing a mobile app version using React Native for push notification alerts.

title: Developers Club - WordPress Resource & Subscription Hub
description: A comprehensive subscription-based digital marketplace and hub for WordPress developers. It provides access to premium themes, plugins, readymade templates, and SEO tools under GPL licensing with flexible membership plans, instant downloads, version changelogs, and role-based access control.
challenges: Architecting a secure download and session verification system using Better Auth & JWT to protect digital GPL assets.
Ensuring ultra-smooth scrolling performance across asset listings and data-heavy changelog tables using Lenis.
Implementing robust role-based access control (RBAC) and notification management within the admin panel for guest and member verification.
futurePlans: Integrating local automated recurring payment gateways (bKash/Nagad) for seamless monthly and yearly subscription renewals.
Developing a custom WordPress companion plugin to enable one-click direct updates inside client WP dashboards.
Adding an interactive community discussion forum and ticketing system for developer troubleshooting and requests.

title: ElectroMart E-Commerce
description: ElectroMart is an online electronics store with interactive filtering and secure checkout. It features real-time product filtering by category, price, and specs, along with a persistent shopping cart, secure checkout workflow, and an intuitive admin dashboard for managing inventory and orders effortlessly.
challenges: Building complex multi-faceted filter logic (price, brand, specifications) with instant state updates.
Ensuring secure payment verification and webhooks processing to update order status reliably.
Managing large product catalogs efficiently using paginated API queries and client-side caching.
futurePlans: Developing an automated AI product recommendation engine based on user browsing history.
Adding an automated warranty claim tracking module for buyers.
Integrating real-time push notifications for flash sales and order status updates.

title: StyleHub E-Commerce Platform
description: A modern full-stack fashion e-commerce platform built for a smooth and engaging online shopping experience. StyleHub allows users to explore fashion collections, browse products by category, view detailed product information, manage their cart, and complete a secure checkout with multiple payment options.
challenges: Building a responsive and visually consistent e-commerce experience across product listing, product details, cart, and checkout pages.
Managing product categories, filtering, sorting, and dynamic product data efficiently across the application.
Implementing a smooth checkout workflow with delivery information, order summary, coupon handling, and multiple payment methods.
Creating smooth page interactions and animations while maintaining a fast and responsive user experience.
futurePlans: Integrating real online payment gateways for a complete production-ready checkout experience.
Adding advanced product filtering, search, wishlist, and personalized recommendations.
Implementing order tracking, customer order history, and a comprehensive admin dashboard.
Adding AI-powered product recommendations and personalized shopping experiences.
